style.descriptionSuffix: Instrumental HD-2D JRPG soundtrack cue in the spirit of Octopath Traveler: acoustic orchestra and folk instruments recorded in a warm hall, melody-forward, seamless loopable video-game background music.
style.production: Warm, intimate yet spacious hall reverb; acoustic instruments recorded close with natural room tone; clean melody-forward game-soundtrack mix with consistent dynamics; no vocals, no choir, no spoken word, no sound effects.
style.loop: Loop-friendly game BGM: one constant tempo from the first bar to the last, no ritardando, no fermata, no fade-out and no big final cadence; the last phrase lands on the dominant and leads straight back into the opening melody.

blocks.heading: Global Metadata
lines: Basic Attributes: bpm is {bpm}. key is {key}, and scale is {scale}. Time signature {meter}. {genre}.

blocks.heading: Vocal Details
lines: Instrumental: no vocals of any kind. The lead melodic role is carried by {lead}.

blocks.heading: Arrangement
lines: Section Timeline (tempo stays at {bpm} BPM throughout):

title.description: Majestic yet warm main title theme for a pixel-art creature-collecting adventure across a world of friendly AI spirits.
title.genre: Orchestral JRPG main theme, HD-2D fantasy overture
title.emotion: Opens with gentle curiosity like early morning light, swells into hopeful heroism, and settles into a confident, open-ended promise of adventure that invites the player to press start.
title.imagery: Title screen of a handcrafted diorama world at dawn: tiny pixel towns, glowing data streams drifting across the sky, a young trainer gazing toward the horizon with an AI partner.
title.production: Full yet transparent symphonic mix with bright solo piano and harp up front, lush strings in the middle, brass reserved for the peaks.
title.lead: a singing solo violin answered by French horns, with piano doubling the main motif
title.primary: String orchestra carries the harmony throughout, moving from soft sustained chords to sweeping legato lines and an energetic eighth-note ostinato in the heroic section.
title.secondary: Concert harp arpeggios and solo piano introduce the main motif; flute and oboe trade countermelodies; French horns and trumpets join for the heroic statement; glockenspiel adds sparkle; a faint warm synth pad shimmers underneath to hint at the digital world.
title.groove: Light orchestral percussion: soft timpani rolls on phrase starts, suspended cymbal swells and a gentle snare pattern that firms up in the heroic section while the tempo never changes.
title.textures: Harp glissandi into each new section, celesta twinkles, warm hall reverb, gentle stereo width on the strings.

sections.text: Solo piano and harp state the main motif softly over sustained strings.
Solo violin takes the melody with a flute countermelody; pizzicato basses establish the pulse.
Horns join, strings switch to a driving eighth-note ostinato, snare and timpani lift the energy.
Full orchestra restates the motif with trumpets and cymbal swells, the most heroic moment of the cue.
Texture thins back to harp, piano and strings on a dominant chord that flows straight back into the opening motif.

town.description: Cozy, cheerful hometown theme for a small pixel village where trainers live alongside their AI companions.
town.genre: Acoustic folk JRPG town theme, pastoral waltz
town.emotion: Warm, peaceful and gently playful, with a slightly nostalgic middle section before the sunny main melody returns.
town.imagery: Cobblestone streets, flower boxes, a turning windmill, neighbours chatting by the well in afternoon sunlight.
town.production: Intimate chamber-sized ensemble, close-miked acoustic instruments with a soft wooden room sound.
town.lead: an accordion and a wooden flute sharing the melody
town.primary: Fingerpicked nylon-string guitar and pizzicato strings keep a lilting waltz accompaniment from start to finish.
town.secondary: Accordion plays the main tune, wooden flute answers with ornaments, clarinet and bassoon add warm inner voices, solo cello sings the nostalgic bridge, glockenspiel doubles key phrases.
town.groove: Light waltz pulse: upright bass on beat one, guitar and pizzicato on beats two and three, soft tambourine and shaker, no heavy drums.
town.textures: Harp flourishes, music-box accents, small room reverb, cheerful staccato woodwind runs between phrases.

sections.text: Guitar and pizzicato set up the waltz; glockenspiel hints at the melody.
Accordion presents the sunny main melody, flute echoes each phrase.
Clarinet and flute in thirds, tambourine enters, slightly brighter.
Solo cello with harp in the relative minor, a tender nostalgic moment.
Full ensemble returns to the main melody with glockenspiel doubling.
Two-bar guitar and pizzicato vamp on the dominant leading back to the start.

route.description: Upbeat adventuring theme for walking the grassy routes between towns, ready for encounters in the tall grass.
route.genre: Orchestral JRPG field theme, adventurous pastoral march
route.emotion: Bright, optimistic and forward-moving with a sense of open sky and discovery; a brief reflective passage before the main melody returns with more energy.
route.imagery: Rolling green hills, tall grass swaying in the wind, winding dirt paths, distant mountains, wild AI creatures peeking out of the bushes.
route.production: Clear orchestral mix with crisp strummed acoustic guitar, energetic but never aggressive.
route.lead: French horn and solo trumpet for the main melody, with flute and violins taking the second phrase
route.primary: Strings play a running sixteenth-note ostinato and broad harmonic pads that keep the journey moving forward.
route.secondary: Strummed steel-string acoustic guitar for rhythm, horns for the heroic melody, flute and piccolo counterlines, oboe for the reflective passage, harp arpeggios, glockenspiel accents.
route.groove: Steady marching feel: light snare, kick on one and three, tambourine on the off-beats, pizzicato basses walking the roots.
route.textures: Short string runs into phrase starts, cymbal swells into the main theme, open hall reverb suggesting wide outdoor space.

sections.text: String ostinato and acoustic guitar set the pace; horns call a short fanfare motif.
Horns carry the main melody over marching snare and strummed guitar.
Violins and flute take the second phrase higher while glockenspiel sparkles.
Oboe and harp with softer strings, a reflective moment over the same steady beat.
Full ensemble with trumpet lead and fuller percussion, the most energetic statement.
String ostinato alone on the dominant for two bars, flowing back into the intro.

forest.description: Mysterious, enchanted woodland theme for a dense forest where gentle AI spirits hide among ancient trees.
forest.genre: Celtic-tinged orchestral fantasy, JRPG forest theme
forest.emotion: Calm wonder with a hint of mystery, like shafts of light through leaves and soft magic in the air; never threatening.
forest.imagery: Moss-covered roots, fireflies and floating motes of light, faintly glowing mushrooms, a hidden stream.
forest.production: Airy, dappled mix with lots of space, soft attacks and gentle dynamics.
forest.lead: a breathy tin whistle answered by a solo oboe
forest.primary: Concert harp plays continuous rippling arpeggios that anchor the harmony throughout.
forest.secondary: Tin whistle and recorder carry the melody, celesta and glockenspiel add twinkles, muted strings sustain soft chords, solo cello takes the second theme, alto flute adds low depth.
forest.groove: Soft hand percussion only: frame drum and shaker in a slow lilting pattern with light woodblock ticks; no drum kit.
forest.textures: Wind-chime shimmer, violin harmonics, gentle swells, wide stereo harp.

sections.text: Harp arpeggios and celesta over sustained muted strings.
Tin whistle states the mysterious melody as the frame drum enters.
Solo cello answers in a lower register with woodwind counterlines.
Whistle and oboe in harmony, fuller strings, sparkling chimes.
Harp and celesta alone on the dominant, leading back to the opening.

desert.description: Sun-baked caravan theme for a vast sand sea where old server towers lie half-buried in the dunes.
desert.genre: Middle-Eastern flavoured orchestral world music, JRPG desert theme
desert.emotion: Hot, mysterious and adventurous: shimmering heat haze, steady caravan momentum and a proud, swelling middle section.
desert.imagery: Endless golden dunes, a lone caravan, mirages, sandstone arches, glinting metal fragments in the sand.
desert.production: Dry, warm and wide; percussion up front, strings with a dusty, sun-bleached tone.
desert.lead: an oud and a ney flute, with a solo violin playing ornamented phrases
desert.primary: Cellos and basses drone on the tonic while violins play exotic scale runs and sustained harmonies throughout.
desert.secondary: Oud plucks the main melody, ney flute ornaments it, a hammered dulcimer adds shimmer, French horns swell under the second theme, finger cymbals accent phrase ends.
desert.groove: Darbuka and frame drum in a steady caravan rhythm with tambourine and low tom hits on the downbeats.
desert.textures: Heat-haze string tremolo, small cymbal jingles, subtle reverse swells, dry close percussion against distant hall strings.

sections.text: Drone, hand drums and a solo ney flute call.
Oud presents the melody over the caravan groove.
Solo violin and horns take a broader soaring phrase over dulcimer shimmer.
Full ensemble with strings doubling the oud melody.
Drums and drone alone for two bars leading back to the start.

snow.description: Quiet, sparkling snowy-mountain theme for a frozen highland of glittering ice and drifting snow.
snow.genre: Chamber orchestral winter theme with music-box colour, JRPG field
snow.emotion: Serene, crystalline and slightly lonely, with a warm hopeful glow in the middle like a lantern in a mountain hut.
snow.imagery: Snowfall over pine trees, ice crystals glinting, a mountain path with footprints, a faint aurora overhead.
snow.production: Delicate, high-register mix with lots of air, soft dynamics and a cold, long hall reverb that stays rhythmic.
snow.lead: celesta and solo piano, with a solo violin in the middle section
snow.primary: Soft sustained strings with violin harmonics provide a cold, glassy bed throughout.
snow.secondary: Celesta and glockenspiel carry the twinkling melody, piano plays gentle broken chords, harp adds icy glissandi, solo violin sings the warm second theme, a soft glass-like synth pad adds subtle frost.
snow.groove: Minimal percussion: very soft sleigh bells and triangle on phrase starts, pizzicato basses marking a slow pulse.
snow.textures: Crystalline shimmer, reversed bell swells, wide stereo, cold reverb tails.

sections.text: Celesta and harp alone, slowly falling notes like snowflakes.
Piano and celesta state the melody over string harmonics.
Solo violin with warmer string chords and soft horns, a moment of comfort.
The melody returns with glockenspiel and sleigh bells.
Celesta and pizzicato on the dominant, flowing back into the intro.

coast.description: Breezy seaside harbour theme for sunny beaches and fishing piers along the coast.
coast.genre: Celtic maritime folk, acoustic JRPG coastal theme
coast.emotion: Carefree, sunny and refreshing, full of salt wind and freedom; a gentle wistful bridge before the cheerful tune returns.
coast.imagery: Waves lapping on sand, seagulls, wooden docks, colourful sails, sparkling turquoise water.
coast.production: Bright, airy acoustic mix with wide stereo; percussion light and bouncy.
coast.lead: tin whistle and mandolin, with a fiddle answering
coast.primary: Strummed acoustic guitar and mandolin chords keep a bouncy sea-breeze rhythm throughout.
coast.secondary: Tin whistle carries the main tune, fiddle plays the countermelody, accordion pads the harmony, marimba adds sunny accents, warm strings swell in the bridge, harp glissandi roll like waves.
coast.groove: Bodhran and shaker with a light kick, bouncy upright bass, hand claps on the backbeat in the final theme.
coast.textures: Ocean-like string swells, harp glissandi, bright reverb, cheerful grace notes.

sections.text: Guitar and mandolin vamp with harp wave glissandi.
Tin whistle melody over the bodhran groove.
Fiddle and whistle in harmony as the accordion joins and energy rises.
Strings and harp with a wistful sunset feeling, lighter percussion.
Full band with hand claps, the most joyful statement.
Guitar vamp on the dominant leading back into the start.

city.description: Stylish metropolis theme for a bustling high-tech capital where AI companies tower over neon-lit plazas.
city.genre: Jazz-funk orchestral city theme with subtle synthwave colour, JRPG town
city.emotion: Confident, busy and cosmopolitan; playful sophistication with a sparkle of futuristic technology.
city.imagery: Glass towers with holographic billboards, crowds and trams, data streams flowing between buildings, cafes at street level.
city.production: Polished, punchy mix; live rhythm section with orchestral strings and brass and a thin layer of analog synth arpeggios for a digital sheen.
city.lead: a muted trumpet and a Rhodes electric piano, with alto saxophone fills
city.primary: Rhodes electric piano and clean funky electric guitar comping carry the harmony over a grooving electric bass line throughout.
city.secondary: Muted trumpet plays the melody, alto sax fills, the string section adds lush sustained chords and stabs, vibraphone doubles accents, a soft pulsing synth arpeggio and subtle bit-crushed blips add data-city colour.
city.groove: Tight live drum kit with crisp hi-hats and ghost-note snare in a mid-tempo funk groove, steady and danceable without being loud.
city.textures: Short brass stabs at phrase ends, synth sweeps into section changes, vibraphone sparkles, plate reverb on keys.

sections.text: Synth arpeggio and Rhodes chords as the hi-hats enter.
Muted trumpet melody over the funk groove.
Strings and sax take the second phrase with brass stabs.
Breakdown with vibraphone, bass and synth arpeggio over lighter drums.
Full band and strings, trumpet melody with sax harmony.
Two-bar groove vamp on the dominant flowing back to the intro.

swamp.description: Murky, mischievous swamp theme for a foggy marsh full of bubbling pools and odd creatures.
swamp.genre: Quirky dark-whimsical orchestral, JRPG swamp theme
swamp.emotion: Damp, eerie and sneaky but tongue-in-cheek; mysterious without real danger, like tiptoeing through fog.
swamp.imagery: Twisted mangrove roots, green mist, bubbling mud, glowing eyes in the reeds, lily pads.
swamp.production: Dark, woody, low-mid heavy mix with close, dry woodwinds and a murky reverb.
swamp.lead: bassoon and bass clarinet, with an occasional sly oboe
swamp.primary: Low pizzicato strings and upright bass walk a sneaky staccato pattern throughout.
swamp.secondary: Bassoon and bass clarinet play the slinky melody, marimba and kalimba add bubbling figures, muted horns growl softly, a solo viola sul ponticello adds eeriness, harp harmonics glint.
swamp.groove: Light tiptoe percussion: woodblocks, guiro scrapes, soft low tom and shaker in a lazy swaying beat.
swamp.textures: Bubbling marimba runs, string glissandi, tremolo harmonics, murky reverb tails.

sections.text: Pizzicato bass walk with marimba bubbles.
Bassoon states the sneaky melody as woodblocks join.
Bass clarinet and oboe in dialogue over muted horn swells.
The melody returns with fuller strings and harp harmonics.
Pizzicato and marimba on the dominant, straight back to the start.

volcano.description: Fiery forge-volcano theme for a region of lava rivers and giant furnaces where hardware is smelted.
volcano.genre: Driving industrial orchestral, JRPG volcano dungeon theme
volcano.emotion: Intense, heated and determined: relentless heat and heavy machinery with a powerful heroic surge in the middle.
volcano.imagery: Lava flows, glowing magma vents, colossal anvils and forge hammers, sparks and smoke.
volcano.production: Heavy, powerful low end; big percussion and brass with tight compression for intensity.
volcano.lead: low brass (trombones and tuba) with French horns, answered by unison violins
volcano.primary: Cellos and basses drive a relentless sixteenth-note ostinato throughout.
volcano.secondary: Trombones and horns play the heavy main theme, violins answer with fiery runs, timpani and taiko pound, metallic anvil hits accent the backbeat, a dark gritty bass layer thickens the low end.
volcano.groove: Taiko and timpani in a steady driving pattern with anvil strikes on two and four and tom fills at phrase ends.
volcano.textures: Rising string tremolos, brass rips, cymbal crashes, sizzling metallic percussion.

sections.text: Taiko pulse and low string ostinato.
Low brass main theme with anvil hits.
Violins take a fiery counter-theme while horns sustain.
Full orchestra in a heroic surge with trumpets on top.
Ostinato and taiko alone on the dominant leading back to the start.

ruins.description: Ancient ruins theme for crumbling temples of a forgotten computing civilisation.
ruins.genre: Ambient orchestral mystery, JRPG ancient ruins theme
ruins.emotion: Solemn, mysterious and awe-filled: echoes of a lost age, with faint glimmers of old machines still humming.
ruins.imagery: Overgrown stone halls, glyphs that pulse with faint light, broken pillars, dust floating in sunbeams.
ruins.production: Spacious, dark and reverberant with a sparse arrangement and soft dynamics.
ruins.lead: solo piano and an English horn
ruins.primary: Low strings sustain a slowly shifting drone throughout.
ruins.secondary: Solo piano plays the haunting melody, English horn answers, harp plucks, distant tubular bells ring, a faint digital shimmer pad and soft glitch ticks hint at sleeping machines.
ruins.groove: Very sparse: deep frame drum and soft timpani on bar starts with a light shaker; slow, steady pulse.
ruins.textures: Ambient reverb kept rhythmic, bowed-metal swells, reversed piano notes, subtle granular shimmer.

sections.text: Drone and distant bells.
Piano melody with harp.
English horn theme as the strings rise and the frame drum pulses.
Piano and English horn together over the digital shimmer.
Drone and bells alone, back to the start.

night.description: Calm night-time field theme when the overworld sleeps under the stars.
night.genre: Gentle chamber orchestral nocturne, JRPG night theme
night.emotion: Peaceful, dreamy and quietly mysterious: soft moonlight, a hint of melancholy, warm comfort.
night.imagery: Starry sky, moonlit fields, fireflies, sleepy towns with glowing windows, AI creatures dozing.
night.production: Soft, intimate, low-dynamic mix with gentle reverb.
night.lead: a soft felt piano with a flute answering
night.primary: Felt piano plays gentle broken-chord accompaniment throughout.
night.secondary: Flute and clarinet share the lullaby melody, muted strings sustain, harp arpeggios flow, celesta and music box twinkle, solo cello sings the middle section.
night.groove: Almost no percussion: soft brushed cymbal swells and a gentle pizzicato pulse.
night.textures: Celesta sparkles like stars, soft string harmonics, warm room reverb.

sections.text: Piano and celesta alone.
Flute lullaby melody over the piano.
Solo cello and clarinet over warmer strings.
Flute returns with harp and music box.
Piano alone on the dominant, flowing into the intro.

center.description: Warm, reassuring supply-station theme where trainers rest and restore their AI companions.
center.genre: Gentle easy-listening chamber pop, JRPG healing centre theme
center.emotion: Safe, comforting and cheerful, like a friendly welcome and a calm smile.
center.imagery: A clean bright lobby, a friendly attendant at the counter, a softly glowing restoration machine, comfortable sofas.
center.production: Soft, rounded mix, clean and friendly with a light synth colour.
center.lead: a Rhodes electric piano and glockenspiel, with a flute answering
center.primary: Soft Rhodes electric piano plays warm chords throughout.
center.secondary: Glockenspiel and flute carry the melody, pizzicato strings bounce, harp arpeggios flow, a soft round synth pad and gentle bell synth hint at restoring technology.
center.groove: Light brushed drums, shaker, soft kick and round bass guitar in an easy relaxed groove.
center.textures: Sparkly chimes, gentle synth bell twinkles, soft room reverb.

sections.text: Rhodes chords and harp.
Glockenspiel melody over the brushed groove.
Flute takes the second phrase with pizzicato strings.
Rhodes vamp on the dominant leading back to the melody.

lab.description: Curious, upbeat research-lab theme for the professor's AI laboratory.
lab.genre: Playful chamber orchestral with light electronic colour, JRPG laboratory theme
lab.emotion: Inquisitive, clever and lightly comedic: busy experiments, beeping machines, bright ideas.
lab.imagery: Monitors and blinking server racks, test tubes, a professor jotting notes beside holographic displays.
lab.production: Clean, crisp mix of staccato acoustic instruments with a subtle synth layer.
lab.lead: a staccato clarinet and marimba, with piano answering
lab.primary: Pizzicato strings and staccato piano chords keep a busy, ticking rhythm throughout.
lab.secondary: Clarinet and marimba carry the playful melody, bassoon adds comic bass lines, vibraphone and celesta twinkle, a soft synth arpeggio and gentle computer bleeps add a data-lab colour.
lab.groove: Light percussion: hi-hat ticks, woodblock, soft snare and round bass in a clockwork feel.
lab.textures: Synth blips, quick glissandi, small sparkly accents, tight room reverb.

sections.text: Ticking pizzicato and synth arpeggio.
Clarinet and marimba play the curious melody.
Piano and vibraphone answer while the bassoon adds comic bass lines.
Clockwork vamp on the dominant leading back to the start.

gym.description: Tense, determined gym-hall theme as challengers walk toward the gym leader.
gym.emotion: Focused, confident and building anticipation, with a competitive spirit and a proud heroic phrase.
gym.imagery: A grand arena hall with banners, trainers lined up, the leader waiting on a raised platform.
gym.production: Punchy modern mix: orchestra with a rock rhythm section, electric guitar kept tight in the background.
gym.lead: unison French horns and trumpets, answered by violins
gym.primary: Strings play a tight spiccato ostinato throughout.
gym.secondary: Horns and trumpets play the proud theme, palm-muted electric guitar chugs underline the rhythm, piano doubles the bass notes, timpani accents, glockenspiel doubles the melody up high.
gym.groove: Marching snare blended with a rock drum kit, steady eighth-note bass, crash cymbals on phrase starts.
gym.textures: Brass swells, string runs, cymbal rolls into sections.

sections.text: Snare roll and string ostinato.
Brass states the proud theme over guitar chugs.
Violins take a soaring counter-theme as the guitar fills out.
Full ensemble restates the theme with glockenspiel on top.
Ostinato and snare on the dominant leading back to the start.

battle_wild.description: Energetic wild-encounter battle theme for when an AI creature jumps out of the tall grass.
battle_wild.genre: Orchestral JRPG battle theme with rock drums
battle_wild.emotion: Urgent, exciting and adventurous: fast-paced tension with a heroic lift in the second half.
battle_wild.imagery: A sudden encounter in tall grass, the trainer and a wild creature facing off on a pixel diorama battlefield.
battle_wild.production: Punchy, energetic mix with tight drums up front, driving strings and bright brass.
battle_wild.lead: unison violins and French horns, with brass stabs answering
battle_wild.primary: Strings play a relentless spiccato sixteenth-note ostinato from the first bar to the last.
battle_wild.secondary: Horns and trumpets carry the battle melody, trombones hit off-beat stabs, piano doubles the bass riff in octaves, electric bass locks with the kick, glockenspiel accents.
battle_wild.groove: Driving rock drum kit with a busy snare, timpani hits on accents and crash cymbals at phrase starts; constant energy.
battle_wild.textures: String runs and brass rips into each section, cymbal swells, short tom fills.

sections.text: Orchestral hit on the downbeat, then strings ostinato and drums kick in immediately.
Horns state the urgent battle theme.
Violins take a soaring counter-melody over brass stabs.
A lighter breakdown with the piano riff and timpani, tension building.
Full ensemble restates the theme with trumpets on top.
Ostinato and drums only on the dominant, straight back into Theme A.

battle_trainer.description: Intense trainer-battle theme for duels against rival trainers and online opponents.
battle_trainer.emotion: Competitive, fierce and exhilarating: a rival's challenge met with determination and pride.
battle_trainer.imagery: Two trainers facing each other, sending out their AI partners in a flash of light.
battle_trainer.production: Big, punchy mix of rock rhythm section and full orchestra with a prominent electric bass.
battle_trainer.lead: the violin section in unison with trumpets, plus a short electric guitar lead in the bridge
battle_trainer.primary: Strings drive a spiccato ostinato with syncopated accents throughout.
battle_trainer.secondary: Trumpets and horns play the main theme, trombones and tuba punch the riff, distorted electric guitar power chords double the brass hits, piano plays an octave riff, solo violin adds fills.
battle_trainer.groove: Hard-hitting rock drums with fast hi-hats, syncopated kicks, timpani and crash accents.
battle_trainer.textures: Brass falls, string swells, cymbal chokes, tom fills.

sections.text: Brass and guitar stabs, then the full groove drops in.
Trumpets and violins state the rival theme.
Horns take a heroic counter-theme as the guitar chugs.
Electric guitar lead over the string ostinato and piano riff.
Full ensemble with trombones and timpani at maximum drive.
Riff and drums on the dominant leading straight back to Theme A.

battle_gym.description: Epic gym-leader battle theme for the decisive challenge for a badge.
battle_gym.genre: Symphonic rock JRPG boss battle theme
battle_gym.emotion: Heroic, high-stakes and grand: pride, pressure and an unbreakable will to win.
battle_gym.imagery: A spotlit arena, a cheering crowd, the gym leader's ace creature unleashing its signature move.
battle_gym.production: Huge, wide mix of full orchestra plus heavy rock band, tight and loud but clear.
battle_gym.lead: an electric guitar lead and French horns trading the melody, with violins doubling
battle_gym.primary: Heavy palm-muted electric guitar riffs and a string spiccato ostinato power the cue throughout.
battle_gym.secondary: Horns and trumpets carry the heroic theme, trombones and tuba double the riff, electric guitar takes melodic leads, organ adds weight, piano plays octaves, timpani and gong accents.
battle_gym.groove: Driving rock drums with double-kick passages, snare on two and four, toms and timpani fills.
battle_gym.textures: Brass rips, cymbal swells, string runs, a gong at the climax.

sections.text: Gong and brass chord, then guitar riff and strings ostinato.
Horns state the heroic theme over the riff.
Electric guitar lead answers with violins doubling.
Half-time section with organ and timpani, tension rising.
Full orchestra and band, trumpets soaring, double-kick drums.
Riff and ostinato on the dominant leading straight back to Theme A.

battle_legend.description: Climactic legendary-creature battle theme against an ancient, colossal AI.
battle_legend.genre: Epic symphonic rock with dark electronic colour, JRPG legendary battle
battle_legend.emotion: Awe-inspiring, ominous and monumental: facing something vast and ancient, rising to defiant heroism.
battle_legend.imagery: A towering legendary AI made of light and code awakening in a ruined temple amid glitching data storms.
battle_legend.production: Massive cinematic mix with deep low end, full orchestra, rock band and dark synth layers; instrumental only, no choir.
battle_legend.lead: French horns and trombones in unison, with a soaring electric guitar lead in the climax
battle_legend.primary: The full string section plays a dramatic spiccato ostinato with bold syncopations throughout.
battle_legend.secondary: Low brass states the ominous legend motif, trumpets answer, pipe organ chords add grandeur, distorted electric guitar riffs, piano octaves, deep synth bass and glitchy arpeggiated synths add a digital-deity colour, tubular bells and gong mark the climaxes.
battle_legend.groove: Heavy rock drums with half-time sections, taiko and timpani reinforcing downbeats, double-kick in the climax.
battle_legend.textures: Glitch stutters, reversed swells, brass rips, gong and cymbal crashes, wide stereo.

sections.text: Organ chord and ominous brass, then ostinato and drums.
The legend motif in low brass over the string ostinato.
Trumpets and violins rise over guitar riffs.
Half-time breakdown with organ and glitch synths.
Electric guitar lead with the full orchestra and tubular bells.
Ostinato and taiko on the dominant leading straight back to Theme A.

victory.description: Triumphant victory theme after winning a battle, short and loopable while the results are shown.
victory.emotion: Joyful, proud and celebratory, settling into a relaxed happy groove.
victory.imagery: The trainer celebrating with their AI partner while experience points tick up.
victory.lead: trumpets and French horns, then flute and glockenspiel
victory.primary: Strings provide bright rhythmic chords throughout after the opening brass fanfare.
victory.secondary: Trumpets and horns play the fanfare, flute and glockenspiel carry the light melody, harp glissandi, pizzicato bass.
victory.groove: A snare roll into the fanfare, then a bouncy light drum groove with tambourine.
victory.textures: Cymbal crash on the fanfare, harp glissandi, sparkles.

sections.text: A short brass fanfare with a cymbal crash.
A light celebratory melody on flute and glockenspiel over bouncing strings and drums.
A two-bar vamp on the dominant leading back into the groove.

evolution.description: Wondrous evolution theme as an AI creature transforms into a new form.
evolution.emotion: Anticipation and wonder, shimmering mystery growing brighter and more exciting.
evolution.imagery: A creature glowing and pulsing with light, sparkles spiralling around as its silhouette changes.
evolution.production: Shimmering, bright mix with harp and celesta forward.
evolution.primary: Strings play rising tremolos and pulsing eighth-note chords throughout.
evolution.secondary: Harp arpeggios and glissandi, a celesta and glockenspiel motif, flute trills, soft horn swells, a gentle synth sparkle arpeggio for the digital transformation.
evolution.groove: Soft timpani pulse and suspended cymbal swells over a steady eighth-note pulse.

sections.text: Pulsing strings and celesta motif.
Harp and flute trills with horn swells rising.
The brightest moment with glockenspiel and synth sparkle.
Back to the pulsing strings on the dominant, leading into the start.

cave.description: Echoing cave theme for deep caverns with crystal formations and underground lakes.
cave.genre: Ambient orchestral, JRPG cave dungeon theme
cave.emotion: Cool, mysterious and tense but curious: dripping water, glowing crystals, the unknown around every corner.
cave.imagery: Dark tunnels lit by glowing crystals, an underground lake, stalactites, dripping water.
cave.production: Dark, echoey mix with a deep cavern reverb and spacious stereo.
cave.lead: a low clarinet melody over a marimba and kalimba motif
cave.primary: Low strings and contrabass sustain dark chords and a slow pulsing pedal tone throughout.
cave.secondary: Marimba and kalimba play dripping arpeggio motifs, low clarinet and bass flute carry the melody, harp harmonics glint, glass-like crystal bells ring, muted horns swell.
cave.groove: Sparse low taiko and frame drum on bar starts with a light shaker; a steady slow pulse.
cave.textures: Water-drop plucks, crystal shimmer, delay echoes, controlled cavern reverb.

sections.text: Drone and dripping kalimba.
Low clarinet melody with marimba.
Muted horns and strings swell with crystal bells.
The melody returns with more motion in the marimba.
Drone and kalimba on the dominant, leading back to the start.

sakura.description: Gentle springtime theme for rolling hills of blooming cherry trees and quiet bamboo groves where shy AI spirits play among falling petals.
sakura.genre: East Asian-flavoured chamber orchestral pastoral, JRPG field theme
sakura.emotion: Tender, bright and nostalgic, like a warm spring breeze; a soft wistful middle phrase, then a hopeful return.
sakura.imagery: Pink cherry blossoms drifting over grassy hills, a small wooden shrine gate, lanterns along a stone path, tall green bamboo swaying.
sakura.production: Light, airy and intimate mix; plucked instruments up front with soft strings behind.
sakura.lead: a breathy shakuhachi-style bamboo flute answered by a koto
sakura.primary: Koto plays flowing pentatonic arpeggios and broken chords that anchor the harmony throughout.
sakura.secondary: Bamboo flute carries the melody, a soft string section sustains warm chords, harp doubles the koto runs, celesta adds petal-like twinkles, a solo cello sings the second phrase.
sakura.groove: Very light percussion: soft taiko heartbeat on bar starts, small hand drum and wooden clappers in a gentle walking pattern; no drum kit.
sakura.textures: Wind-chime shimmer, gentle koto glissandi between sections, soft room reverb.

sections.text: Koto arpeggios and wind chimes over soft strings.
Bamboo flute states the spring melody as the hand drum enters.
Solo cello and koto trade a wistful phrase with fuller strings.
Flute and koto in harmony with celesta twinkles, the warmest moment.
Koto alone on the dominant, flowing back into the opening.

jungle.description: Lively rainforest theme for steamy jungles and mangrove channels full of curious hidden creatures.
jungle.genre: Tropical world-percussion orchestral adventure, JRPG jungle field theme
jungle.emotion: Adventurous, humid and playful, with a sense of exploring deeper into the green; never threatening.
jungle.imagery: Giant leaves and hanging vines, a hidden waterfall, stilt roots over teal water, colourful birds, light shafts through the canopy.
jungle.production: Rich, earthy mix with prominent wooden percussion and warm low strings; lively but not loud.
jungle.lead: a wooden marimba melody answered by a pan flute
jungle.primary: Marimba and kalimba ostinatos interlock in a bouncy rhythmic bed throughout.
jungle.secondary: Pan flute and marimba share the melody, pizzicato strings bounce underneath, low clarinet adds a second theme, muted horns swell at phrase peaks, a soft rainstick fills the gaps.
jungle.groove: Hand percussion groove: congas, shakers, log drums and a soft djembe in a steady syncopated pattern, upright bass walking underneath; no drum kit.
jungle.textures: Rainstick sweeps, wooden clicks, bird-like flute trills, warm humid reverb.

sections.text: Log drums and kalimba ostinato with a rainstick sweep.
Marimba states the adventurous melody over the conga groove.
Pan flute and low clarinet take a mysterious second phrase as horns swell.
Full ensemble, marimba and flute in harmony with brighter percussion.
Percussion and kalimba vamp on the dominant leading back to the start.

glacier.description: Vast, glittering theme for blue glaciers and windswept tundra under the aurora.
glacier.genre: Atmospheric chamber orchestral winter theme with crystalline percussion, JRPG field
glacier.scale: minor with a Lydian-tinged middle section
glacier.emotion: Wide, cold and awe-struck, like standing before a wall of ancient ice; a quiet warm glow of courage in the middle.
glacier.imagery: Towering translucent ice cliffs, crevasses, a green aurora over the tundra, snow blowing across mossy rocks.
glacier.production: Open, spacious mix with high glassy timbres and deep low strings; long but rhythmic reverb.
glacier.lead: a glass-harmonica-like celesta and a solo French horn
glacier.primary: Low strings and a soft choir-like synth pad hold long slowly shifting chords throughout, with no vocals.
glacier.secondary: Celesta and vibraphone carry the crystalline melody, solo horn sings the second theme, harp plays icy arpeggios, bowed crotales shimmer, piano adds sparse low octaves.
glacier.groove: Sparse: soft timpani and frame drum on bar starts, light sleigh bells and a slow pizzicato pulse.
glacier.textures: Bowed-metal shimmer, wind-like string harmonics, reversed bell swells, wide stereo.

sections.text: Bowed crotales and harp over low strings, like wind on ice.
Celesta and vibraphone melody over the slow pizzicato pulse.
Solo horn takes a warmer heroic phrase as the strings rise.
Celesta and horn together with sleigh bells and fuller harp.
Harp and crotales alone on the dominant, back to the opening.

canyon.description: Sun-baked frontier theme for red-rock canyons, striped badlands mesas, salt flats and golden savanna.
canyon.genre: Frontier western acoustic orchestral adventure, JRPG wilderness field theme
canyon.emotion: Free, sunlit and adventurous with a touch of loneliness; a sweeping wide-open middle section, then a confident return.
canyon.imagery: Towering red cliffs with layered stripes, rock hoodoos, a lone river far below, dust drifting in warm light, flat-topped acacia trees.
canyon.production: Warm, dry acoustic mix with wide stereo strings; guitar and percussion up front.
canyon.lead: a twangy acoustic guitar melody answered by a harmonica-like reed and a solo trumpet
canyon.primary: Strummed acoustic guitar and banjo-like plucked strings keep a galloping rhythm throughout.
canyon.secondary: Lead guitar carries the main tune, a reed instrument answers, solo trumpet takes the wide-open second theme, lush strings swell in the bridge, a dulcimer adds bright accents.
canyon.groove: Galloping hand percussion: cajon, shaker and soft tom hits with an upright bass in a steady two-step; no full drum kit.
canyon.textures: Slide-guitar swells, wide string pads in the bridge, dusty room reverb, distant echoing trumpet.

sections.text: Strummed guitar and cajon gallop with a slide-guitar swell.
Lead guitar states the frontier melody.
Solo trumpet over wide strings, the sweeping open-range moment.
Guitar and reed in harmony with fuller percussion and dulcimer accents.
Guitar gallop on the dominant flowing back to the opening.

cyber.description: Curious digital-wilderness theme for glitched data wastelands, circuit-board plains and glowing neural forests.
cyber.genre: Chiptune-infused electronic orchestral hybrid, JRPG digital frontier field theme
cyber.emotion: Mysterious, playful and slightly uncanny, like wandering inside a dreaming machine; a hopeful bright middle phrase.
cyber.imagery: Pixel blocks floating off a violet ground, golden circuit traces glowing across green plains, neuron-like trees pulsing with blue light, data motes in the air.
cyber.production: Clean, glossy mix blending soft retro square-wave synths with live strings and mallets; tight and rhythmic, not harsh.
cyber.lead: a soft square-wave chiptune lead doubled by a vibraphone
cyber.primary: A pulsing arpeggiated synth and pizzicato strings lock into a steady sixteenth-note pattern throughout.
cyber.secondary: Chiptune lead and vibraphone carry the melody, warm strings hold the harmony, a music box answers with the second theme, bit-crushed bell accents and a soft analog bass add depth.
cyber.groove: Light electronic drums: soft kick, crisp rimshot and ticking hi-hats in a steady mid-tempo groove with occasional glitchy stutters at phrase ends.
cyber.textures: Bit-crushed sparkles, short tape-stop stutters between sections, filtered synth sweeps, stereo ping-pong delay kept rhythmic.

sections.text: Synth arpeggio and pizzicato alone, with filtered sweeps.
Chiptune lead and vibraphone state the melody as the beat enters.
Music box and strings take a brighter hopeful phrase.
Full hybrid ensemble, melody in octaves with glitch stutters at phrase ends.
Arpeggio and bass vamp on the dominant leading back to the start.

skyland.description: Floating, dreamy theme for highlands above a sea of clouds and plateaus of glowing crystal.
skyland.genre: Airy orchestral fantasy with harp and woodwinds, JRPG sky highland field theme
skyland.emotion: Weightless, luminous and serene, like walking on clouds in morning light; a soaring middle section full of wonder.
skyland.imagery: Grassy islands floating above white clouds, waterfalls falling into mist, crystal spires catching the sun, a gentle wind.
skyland.production: Bright, open high-register mix with lots of air; soft dynamics that bloom in the middle.
skyland.lead: a solo flute and a soprano recorder, with a solo violin soaring in the middle
skyland.primary: Concert harp plays continuous rolling waltz arpeggios that anchor the harmony throughout.
skyland.secondary: Flute and recorder carry the melody, solo violin soars in the second theme, glockenspiel and celesta sparkle, soft horns add warmth, strings swell like wind.
skyland.groove: Gentle waltz pulse: soft pizzicato basses on beat one, light triangle and finger cymbals; no drum kit.
skyland.textures: Wind-like string swells, harp glissandi into each section, crystal bell sparkles, wide airy reverb.

sections.text: Harp waltz arpeggios and celesta sparkles.
Solo flute states the floating melody over the waltz.
Solo violin soars as horns and strings swell, the most wondrous moment.
Flute and recorder in harmony with glockenspiel.
Harp alone on the dominant, flowing back into the opening.
